children: ), a global company that redefines the boundaries of protection – safeguarding and servicing connected devices, homes, automobiles, and commercial equipment in partnership with the world’s leading brands, will release third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, after the market closes. The news release will be available on Assurant's website at www.assurant.com. In conjunction with the news release, Assurant will host a conference call the following morning, Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET. The call will be available to the public via live audio webcast.

Keith Demmings, President and Chief Executive Officer, Keith Meier, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Sean Moshier, Vice President, Investor Relations, will review third quarter 2026 results during the call.

The live audio webcast, investor presentation and supplemental information will be accessible in the Investor Relations section of Assurant's website. An archived replay of the webcast also will be available shortly after the live event.
